reviews.text: I just had the outside of my house painted by Tex Painting and I couldn’t be happier! They started the job right away and got it done quickly. The crew was very conscientious and took pride in their work. They paid attention to detail, including the clean-up. They were great to work with and delivered more than he promised. And the price was great! I’d recommend Tex Painting to anyone!

The experience was exemplary from the very start. We worked with George who, from the beginning, we could tell wanted to ensure our satisfaction. The initial quote was a bit higher than our budget, and a bit higher than other quotes too, and George was happy to accommodate a discount to help make it more affordable. The painters did an outstanding job, and even when some unexpected walls came up (ones we forgot to point out above our stairs), George accommodated it with a smile. Our house looks beautiful!

Tex Painting did an excellent job painting my exterior home in Cedar Park. I had several other painting contractors come to my home only 3 out of 7 actually submitted a quote. Scott Miller with Tex Painting gave me a quote on the spot, which I really appreciated. They we’re not the cheapest quote I received but not even close to being the most expensive. The crew that painted my house was top notch, even patiently awaited my last minute color change. I could not be more pleased with the outcome. I actually feel proud to come home. I highly recommend!

about.title: It began with knocking on doors in 78704.
text: As a junior at the University of Texas, Scott Miller started a small exterior painting business in the 78704 zip code and spent a spring semester knocking on doors for it.
That summer he recruited two college friends to paint 25 homes in Travis Heights, and he learned that a good referral is priceless.
Today we are family owned and locally operated, not a national franchise, and every contract spells out the scope of work and the exact products we will use.
